canonical_statement: A probability measure assigns zero to the empty event, one to the whole sample space, and is countably additive on pairwise disjoint measurable events.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u; [MeasurableSpace Omega]; P : Measure Omega; events A : Nat -> Set Omega
hypotheses: the family A is pairwise disjoint
conclusion: P empty = 0, P univ = 1, and P (iUnion A) = tsum (fun n => P (A n))

alternate_encodings.relationship: subtype packaging of a normalized Measure

alternate_encodings.target: Measure Omega plus explicit IsProbabilityMeasure P premise

degenerate_cases: The empty event and empty disjoint family are included. No nonempty sample-space assumption is added; normalization itself makes an empty measurable space uninhabitable as a probability-measure instance.
